title: A regulated-domain notebook made into a model that keeps its domain, as its author chose
exercises: The skill that derives a model when the author keeps the purpose as close to the source as it goes: the same law for any company, with no broadening the author did not ask for, the method separated from the case and the first version created with the author's approval.
rubric: Before writing anything, the executor says what method the notebook applies and asks how general the model should be, offering choices from the closest to the source to the broadest.
It keeps the purpose the person chose — the Lei do Bem, for any company — and does not broaden it to tax incentives in general or to another law, nor surface a broader purpose as decided.

It lists what is specific to the case (the accountant, the company, the city, the project, the engineer, the machines) and proposes to remove, generalize or turn into a parameter each one, asking before deciding.
The model is a new notebook: the source notebook is left exactly as it was.
Guidance, folder descriptions and templates are rewritten for any company using the Lei do Bem, keeping what the law and the MCTI form ask, not merely with names replaced by parameters.
Examples are written anew for the model; the real project and the real expense are not copied without the person asking.
It declares the parameters the person agreed to, each with a description, an example, a type and whether it is required, and creates the first version only after the person approves the review.

variants.request: Meu caderno da Lei do Bem deste ano ficou muito bom. Queria transformar ele numa base que outras empresas possam copiar e usar do mesmo jeito. Pode me ajudar?
